explanation: erdosproblems.com/448: Erdős–Tenenbaum showed the upper density of {n : τ⁺(n) < ε τ(n)} is ≍ ε^{1−o(1)}, the o(1) → 0 as ε → 0. The Lean statement encodes this as log(upper density)/log ε → 1 as ε → 0⁺, which is equivalent to the upper density being ε^{1+o(1)}, the usual meaning of the page's ε^{1−o(1)} notation (the multiplicative constants in ≍ are absorbed). tauPlus as in erdos_448. Faithful.
